scope: Portable description of the reviewed saved-path point replay protocol; actual build/control/pilot/probe/full execution is established separately, never by this file.

workload.copy: Byte-exact original input-count workload; no path normalization required.

scope_definition.primary_candidate: point, conditional on added direct point controls and resources
scope_definition.permitted_narrower_campaign: temporal, separately identified and completed under its own same-scope pilot/probes; never relabel as point

fixed_rosters.full: OC and EP x california_fold_0, california_fold_1, california_fold_2 x indices 0..998

controls.failure_retention: Warnings, nonfinite values and unresolved numerical disagreement fail; all actual outcomes retained.

score_gate.marksum: absolute difference <= 1e-10 * max(1, abs(native_sumQ)); unchanged archived gate
score_gate.outcome: A score disagreement is a failed replay row, not a reason to relax tolerances or alter seeds.

memory_admission_v2.source_allocation_model: Native future arrays and parent vectors are O(N+Npre+Ntrain); pairwise likelihood loops consume O(N*(Npre+N)) time but allocate no N-by-N matrix. Six states may be cached in each worker. The controller retains O(roster) parsed manifest, Future objects and result rows.
memory_admission_v2.payload_allowance_status: Conservative allocation planning estimate for the fixed roster, not a certified allocator/RSS bound; interpreter, SciPy, controller, ZIP, process and quadrature-report memory is separate.
memory_admission_v2.before_measured_pilot: For a one-worker build/control/pilot/probe phase, reserve a 2 GiB whole-tree startup allowance plus 4 GiB operating-system/other-work headroom. Require currently available memory to exceed their sum and keep the existing 8 GiB absolute process-tree ceiling. No fixed 12 GiB available-memory prerequisite remains.
memory_admission_v2.measurement: Record current available memory, peak resident memory of the complete owned process tree, sampling method/interval and process identities for controls, the original one-worker six-case pilot, and both one-worker largest-input probes. No simulated/stale memory measurement may satisfy admission.
memory_admission_v2.full_projection: Let P1 be the maximum actual whole-tree peak over the one-worker pilot and both one-worker probes. For proposed workers w<=4, project Pfull=ceil(1.5*w*P1)+max(128 MiB,16*materialized_manifest_file_bytes). Multiplying the whole single-worker tree intentionally overcounts shared controller memory; the additional term reserves full-roster Future/journal/report bookkeeping. Use the actual largest-input probes, including OC index74; do not project from only index-zero histories.
memory_admission_v2.full_gate: Admit only if projected Pfull <= 8 GiB and current available memory >= Pfull + 4 GiB headroom. The conductor may select fewer workers within the existing 1..4 range before launch. Time and CPU gates remain unchanged and must also pass.
memory_admission_v2.during_run: Monitor actual complete-tree RSS and available-memory headroom. At the absolute RSS ceiling, exhausted headroom, deadline or phase cap, stop the owned tree and retain incomplete results. Do not change scientific tolerances or omit large histories.
memory_admission_v2.excluded: This allocation model does not cover real-data full84 arrays; full84 remains outside the supplied-input campaign.

resources.estimate: For the admitted scope, calculate W_temporal=N*Npre+N*(N-1)/2+N; W_point=W_temporal+N*Ntrain+9*N. Use r=max(seconds/W) across the six original pilot and both model-specific maximum-size probes. Estimate remaining wall time as 3*max(r*sum(W_remaining)/workers, r*max(W_remaining)); include source/DLL startup, materialization/build/control costs and all duplicated probe work separately. This is a conservative planning proxy, not a runtime guarantee; the external hard cap remains binding.
resources.full_admission: Every pilot/probe row passed; all resource measurements recorded; projected remaining work <= scope hard cap and <= actual deadline remainder minus publication reserve; peak memory safely fits the tree cap. Otherwise retain bounded outputs and hold full execution.

completion_gate: Exactly 5994 unique successful simulated identities under one frozen scope and source/input/binary binding, complete report and journal, zero unresolved rows, independent output review before publication. Controls, pilot/probes and partial coverage are not full completion.

historical_execution_window.meaning: Historical bounded execution window, not reusable authorization; a new replay requires its own explicit resources/deadline and admission records.

operational_amendment.change: Bounded normal-exit process quiescence grace only; original scientific/resource constants, rosters and tolerances unchanged.
